title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Loyalty Restoration Discount
content:
# Loyalty restoration discount (Wayfare Pass)

**Clause.** When a past-due Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership is restored, the loyalty restoration discount is 10 percent for a member who has held the membership for at least 18 whole months and has no declined scheduled renewal in the 12 months before the restoration other than the one being restored; it is 5 percent for a member who does not meet that tier but has held the membership for at least 6 whole months and has at most one such other declined scheduled renewal; it is nothing for anyone else.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the restoration payment as that percentage of the membership fee the payment collects for the period in force. The percentage is always of that membership fee amount itself, the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the payment is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Terms used

- **Whole months held**: whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the restoration date.
- **Declined scheduled renewal**: a declined attempt on the membership ledger that is the scheduled attempt of a renewal, not a retry. The scheduled attempt declined for the period being restored is not counted; any other dated in the 12 months before the restoration is.

## Tier table

| Whole months held | Other declined scheduled renewals in the last 12 months | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 18 or more | none | 10 percent |
| 18 or more | exactly one | 5 percent |
| 18 or more | two or more | nothing |
| 6 to 17 | none or one | 5 percent |
| 6 to 17 | two or more | nothing |
| under 6 | any number | nothing |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical)

- 18 whole months held, no other declined scheduled renewal: 10 percent. 17 whole months, same record: 5 percent.
- 6 whole months held, one other declined scheduled renewal: 5 percent. 5 whole months, same record: nothing.
- 30 whole months held, two other declined scheduled renewals: nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A Wayfare Pass Monthly member at the 10 percent tier whose restoration payment collects the full 9.99 fee: 10 percent of 9.99 is 0.999, taken off unrounded, leaving 8.991, which rounds to 8.99.
